name: Economatica S.A.
summary: Economatica S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a technology, data, and market intelligence company in Brazil. The company's services include professional and managerial training and development focused on the financial and business area; operation of internet pages and portals that periodically update their content, generating and maintaining information about the Brazilian financial, business and political system; portals, content providers and other internet information services; development of custom computer programs; development and licensing of customizable and non-customizable computer programs; information technology consulting; and technical support, maintenance and other information technology services; administration, brokerage and agency of insurance; and distribution of securities. The company operates through three platforms, Economatica, a financial data analysis platform for fundamental and quantitative investment research; Sencon, an income tax platform for individual investors; and Pandhora, a hybrid asset management company. The company was formerly known as TC S.A. and changed its name Economatica S.A. in June 2026. Economatica S.A. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
